# Remote Control Agent v0.1.47 — legacy Windows Owner Stop

## Changes

- Repair the real native Windows Owner Stop failure on older paired permanent devices upgraded to v0.1.46 that lack the new `.install-mode` marker (Agent PR #104).
- On a genuine owner-local Stop **only**, require the existing Windows same-owner user-logon task (validated SID, exact program/entry and HTTPS endpoint) to be running, validate the local key and previously approved exact device ID through a fresh signed cloud proof, and require the existing permanent-only cloud Owner Stop challenge.
- Only after rechecking the unchanged user task, exclusively create and ACL-seal the missing `permanent` mode using the existing private-store helper. This does not itself Stop, Resume, re-pair, rotate keys or alter receipts; the normal signed Stop remains mandatory.
- Missing mode for Start, temporary/invalid mode, mismatched identity, missing or stopped task, revoked/expired/temporary cloud grants and unavailable verification remain fail-closed. No new Worker endpoint, runtime service, or deployment workflow.

## Release and real-device acceptance boundary

This manifest prepares **the existing protected immutable Agent Release workflow**. Do not merge this file to main without explicit owner release approval: a merge to main matching `.github/release-pins/*.json` automatically launches release publication. **This Draft PR itself does not publish or deploy.**

After a separately approved publication, use the reviewed pinned owner-local Windows installer in genuine Windows PowerShell to upgrade the existing v0.1.46 installed task **without re-pair**. Then execute one genuine owner-local `rca stop`, independently verify protected OFF and cloud deadline, followed by `rca start` and independent signed WSS/Remote Control command verification. Existing Windows and WSL2 Agent status, device identity, cloud grants and receipts must be preserved. Actual native Stop/Resume, Worker public installer repin, natural 14-day expiry and reboot/logon persistence are not established by candidate CI.
